summary: An array stores a fixed number of values of one type. You get each value by its index, starting at 0.
notes: int[] scores = {88, 92, 75}; makes an array of length 3.
scores.length has no parentheses. It is a field, not a method.
Arrays.copyOf(scores, 4) makes a new array of length 4. The extra slot starts at 0.
pitfall: Using scores[scores.length] causes ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The last index is scores.length - 1.
